parameters.content:
## Northgate 1: Apply Form
The public application form (`/form/northgate-apply`): job, name, email, CV as a PDF, right to work, notice period and salary expectation.

**Prepare Application** checks the answers and the file (PDF, under 5 MB), then the CV goes to **Northgate 2** in the background. The applicant sees a thank-you page straight away and never sees a score.
